questions.text: Which personal and institution details should the tenant enter besides the volume figures (e.g. contact person name, phone, email, hospital name, address, registration number)? Which of these are mandatory?
questions.answer: contact person name, phone, email, hospital name, address, registration number/upload registration certificate

questions.text: What time period do the volume figures (USGs, deliveries, caesareans, NICU, MTPs) cover: per month, per year, or something else? Are they self-declared estimates, with no verification?
questions.answer: per year or more if available means maximum available

questions.text: What exactly does 'No. NICU things' mean: NICU admissions per period, number of NICU beds, or both?
Should 'No. of deliveries' include caesareans (with caesareans as a subset), or should it count only normal deliveries?
questions.answer: No. of deliveries' include caesareans (with caesareans as a subset)

questions.text: Where does this form sit in the blueprint's onboarding flow: during the initial application (with the government certificate upload), or after ratification alongside department selection? Can the tenant edit the figures later, or are they locked like departments?
questions.answer: At the timing of first signing, govt certificate can be uploaded later, it is not mandatory in first sign in

questions.text: Do these figures feed anything downstream, for example the 'Double Delivery Figure' / 'Original Delivery Averages' subscription model or Super Admin review? Or are they informational only?
questions.answer: They feed downstream - means it has to be noted/alerted when they become double, triple and so on....
